name: Cut Caffeine & Screens Before Bed
equipment: None -- just a plan for the evening
instructions: Stop caffeine (coffee, tea, soda, energy drinks) by early-to-mid afternoon -- it can still affect sleep quality 6+ hours after you drink it.
Set a screen curfew 30-60 minutes before bed; the blue light from phones and TVs suppresses melatonin production.
If you must use a screen, switch on a night-mode/warm-light filter to reduce the effect.
Use tonight's wind-down meditation as your screen-free replacement activity for that last half hour.
